purpose: Check current cap contracts at every cast and tick in advancing BattleRoom encounters, with legal equipment and current visible-hand strategy. No production candidate or balance change.
weapon_level: Equal to declared equipment level (0 or 5); fixed within each pair
other_levels: All six levels remain in the previous 864-row OFFLINE boundary matrix; this encounter experiment covers the two declared endpoints and does not replace that coverage.
deck: C01-C07,C17,C18,C20,C25,C26,C27,C29 and the six class cards 01-06, twenty unique enabled codex cards at level zero; DeckRules validates each hero.
input_revision: Before any full experiment, replace three common slots with C17 shield and C20/C27 draw-block sources. Pilot revision 1 lacked these legal sources for Mage T03 and all-hero T02 PVE conversion. Preserve all revision-1 pilot originals; they do not prove the missing predicates. No card values or production deck are changed.
equipment_pair: Five Purple items in distinct slots versus the same items with Head quality Orange. Same declared element, level, Bulwark affix and DrawInterval trait; at most one Orange, no Red. Every changed numerical attribute is recorded.
pair_interpretation: One item-quality change affects several existing equipment attributes. Differences in outcomes are descriptive and cannot isolate resistance, draw rate or shield effects. Zero cap marginal means the declared resistance component only, not zero overall equipment benefit.
strategy: Current basic strategy, visible hand and living targets only; no library or future intent inspection
required_actual_events: Every player cast: original selected order, card shield bases, health cost, requested/effective/overflow and unchanged candidate policies

Every room tick: original before/after scalar state, independent piecewise draw charge integration and hand-full reset, equipment raw and effective resistance, current clamp/conversion stages and status expiry
Actual first three previews retain original no-mutation and real-play parity checks
case_applicability: T01 above-cap events required for every level-five element/hero/group/arm; level-zero below-cap observations are separate. T02 equipment clamp, card speed, PVE conversion and expiry require actual events; missing events remain a gap. T03 positive shield, zero capacity and overflow have separate counts; no applicable event cannot pass its predicate.
statistics: Contract experiment only; retain all paired outcomes and numerical metrics by stratum. No significance, equivalence, isolated causal effect or new balance candidate is claimed.
outcomes: Victory, Death, Censored and Error retained. Longer Guardian fights are not a contract failure when progressing; censoring remains an observed outcome.

pilot.acceptance: Execution and independent-validator check only; full experiment and applicability remain pending

storage: Bounded cloud RAM output; stream completed units to G, verify archive bytes/members, gzip CRC and original raw hashes/counts before cloud cleanup. Failed originals and active inputs retained.
